name: LSASS Memory Dump via comsvcs.dll MiniDump
description: Detects use of rundll32.exe to call the undocumented MiniDump export of comsvcs.dll against the LSASS process, a living-off-the-land technique to dump credential material without dropping a separate dumping tool. Source: detections/rules/proc_creation_win_lsass_dump_comsvcs.yml, compiled from Sigma via sigma-cli (eql, ecs_windows pipeline).
query: any where process.executable.caseless:"*\\rundll32.exe" and process.command_line:"*comsvcs.dll*" and process.command_line:"*MiniDump*"
false_positives: Legitimate memory-dump troubleshooting by an administrator who knows what they're doing
author: Sentinel
